speaker: Sheldon
text: Dr. Custer, folly is your superior. I forbid you from riding on my board. I am in every way.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, lord. You are not my superior.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Can you do this? Nice working with you. I'm sorry. For you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Doing what? Alright, you've made your point.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What do you want, Sheldon? I looked over the board, and it turns out you were right. I didn't say that. Nevertheless, I didn't say it. Anyway, I would like you to come back and work for me.

speaker: Sheldon
text: So you were wrong. That's the only logical inference.

speaker: Sheldon
text: In this context, for me could mean with me. Alright, but I have some conditions.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I reject them all. I'll take the job. See you Monday.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait, you have to drive me home. I walked. I can't. There's a big dog outside. On the way home, we can start thinking about methods of optimizing the detector for 500 GeV particles.

speaker: Sheldon
text: How did you get here? So walk home.
